VBO:0200875.summary: Often sweet-natured and adaptable, the Mi-Ki was developed as a companion dog. Mikki Mackin began its breeding program in Wisconsin, aiming for a calm, quiet nature. The original dogs brought together Shih Tzu ancestry and several other toy-dog lines before later breeders continued developing the companion breed.
VBO:0200875.shortDescription: A sweet-natured companion developed from several toy-dog lines, with calmness among its breeders’ aims.

sources.title: Mi-Ki: Official UKC Breed Standard (revised January 2, 2024)
sources.evidence: Character supports sweet-natured/adaptable companion; History states Wisconsin founder Mikki Mackin and calm/quiet selection aim, Shih Tzu and other toy lines with incomplete mixing records. Exact date and genetic percentages omitted; no health, shedding, therapy or suitability guarantee.

VBO:0200837.summary: Friendly, willing and active, the Lucas Terrier is a sturdy small dog developed for terrier work. Sir Jocelyn Lucas began the line in the 1940s by crossing a Norfolk Terrier with one of his Ilmer Sealyhams. The original club continues to preserve those Ilmer bloodlines through a small breeding programme.
VBO:0200837.shortDescription: A friendly, willing and active small working terrier whose club preserves Sir Jocelyn Lucas's original Ilmer bloodlines.

sources.title: Lucas Terrier Club — Home
sources.evidence: Current club describes willing and active temperament and preservation of direct original Ilmer lines through small breeding program. Family/older-owner suitability statements excluded.

sources.title: Lucas Terrier Club — Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Friendly character ideal and sturdy working-terrier identity; registered dog must descend from Ilmer Lucas; moderate natural undocked tail straight/erect/no curl accepted. No individual temperament guarantee.

sources.title: Lucas Terrier Club — History
sources.evidence: 1940s Sir Jocelyn Lucas Norfolk/Ilmer Sealyham founding and unbroken lines, present small preservation program. Explicitly distinguishes Sporting Lucas 1999 breakaway with extra terrier genes; no Sporting trait transfer.

VBO:0200829.summary: Good-natured yet energetic and persistent on a trail, the Lithuanian Hound combines endurance with a melodious, changing voice. Its work includes finding fresh game tracks and following wounded animals, tasks that draw on keen scent and good orientation. The modern breed was rebuilt from surviving local hounds beginning in 1957–58, with a first provisional standard in 1966.
VBO:0200829.shortDescription: An energetic, good-natured Lithuanian hound with a melodious voice, persistent tracking and a strong sense of direction.

sources.title: Lithuanian Kennel Club — Lithuanian Hound standard, 2019
sources.evidence: Current2019 Paskirtis and temperament describe energetic/good-natured persistent enduring hound, melodious changing tracking voice, fresh-game and wounded-game scent/orientation work. Historical summary records modern reconstruction1957–58 and provisional1966standard. No FCI recognition, universal behavior/suitability/intelligence or ancient continuity claim.
